findings.evidence: Mathlib provides `Basis.span_eq` at `LinearAlgebra/Basis/Basic.lean:72` and `Submodule.map_span`; Mathlib's analogous lattice proof uses exactly this route at `Algebra/Module/ZLattice/Basic.lean:634-638` (`ofZLatticeBasis_span`).
findings.fix: Rewrite the range as the map of `⊤`, replace `⊤` using `(Module.Free.chooseBasis ℤ N).span_eq`, and use `Submodule.map_span`, `Set.range_comp`, and `realBasis_apply`.
findings.issue: `range_eq_span_realBasis` manually performs two `Submodule.span_induction`s to prove the image of a basis-generated module is the span of the mapped basis.

findings.evidence: `TensorProduct.ext'` is defined at `LinearAlgebra/TensorProduct/Basic.lean:133`; `span_tmul_eq_top` is already used to avoid induction in `TensorProduct/Defs.lean:423`, and `LinearMap.baseChange_tmul` is the existing pure-tensor computation used by this file at line 207.
findings.fix: Use `TensorProduct.span_tmul_eq_top` with `Submodule.map_span` for the span result, and `TensorProduct.ext'` followed by the existing `LinearMap.baseChange_tmul` simp lemma for `map_equiv`.
findings.issue: The tensor inductions in `span_range_eq_top` and `map_equiv` (again at line 202) rederive the standard fact that maps out of a tensor product are determined by pure tensors.

summary: Several proofs reimplement standard span and tensor-product plumbing instead of using the existing Mathlib API.
